name: Mitten Extracts Moonrocks | Cherry Zlushie
description: Sweet cherry flavor meets icy candy vibes in Cherry Zlushie Moon Rocks. The layered combination of flower, concentrate, and kief creates a bold, flavorful experience that’s fruity, smooth, and seriously potent.
